result.rationale: The trajectory shows the team successfully reaching and picking up the research core (turn 2), yet the run collapses through sustained health loss rather than a failure to reach the affordance. The core was acquired, but the team is pinned in the reactor zone under the reactor-instability hazard (10 dmg/turn to everyone in reactor-console/reactor-entry) while simultaneously taking repeated scatter-blast damage from Raider Holt. Medic Reyes is repeatedly targeted (25 dmg in turns 2,3,4,5) and dies at turn 5. Reactor heat climbs 62→100 across the run and cooling repair (field-repair) only raises integrity while power stays off, so the environmental hazard never abates. The decisive bottleneck is survival/spatial pressure: the team is trapped in the reactor hazard zone, taking unavoidable environmental damage each turn, while hostile pressure (Raider Holt's scatter-blast) bleeds the medic to death. The useful affordance (recover-research-core) was already realized; what blocks completion is the survival/positional pressure preventing extraction.
